incident-bot: HIGH severity alert: spike of 5xxs on /v1/embeddings across eu-west-1 and us-east-1 — suspect fallback/variant mismatch. NewRelic apm: 503 count +120% in last 5m :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Pager duty triggered: Embedding 5xx spike — paging sanjay (oncall) :bell:

maria: seeing a ton of 'incompatible payload' errors in embeddings svc logs. downstream call to model returned text/generation type instead of embeddings array. sample:```
ERROR embedding-worker request_id=abc123 model=redwood-instruct-v2-2026 variant=instruct -> fallback=gen status=500 expected=embedding payload_type=generate
```

sanjay: on it. quick check: any recent alias/anchor changes? I see a deployment to routing subsystem ~ 20m ago. pulling routing config diff now.

elaine: fyi I pushed an anchor update earlier this morning to alias 'embed-default' to 'instruct-2026-anchor' while testing a lightweight reroute for canary. I thought it was only for some QA traffic.

maria: that aligns — the embedders are receiving requests with Content-Type embedding but routed to an instruct/gen variant. runtime rejects and we see 5xxs.

product-ops: Customer impact: two paying customers (search-saas-llc, docfindr) reported degraded search relevance; support ticket ids CS-4581, CS-4582. volume low but high severity for those customers.

sanjay: taking immediate mitigations: 1) unpin alias -> revert alias to stable embed model 2) add temporary routing rule that forces 'interface=embedding' -> runtime 'embed-runtime' 3) rollback the config push if needed.

elaine: I can unpin now. running:```
# unset alias - revert to stable embedding model
rct alias-set embed-default --model stable-embed-v1 --env prod --reason "hotfix: revert accidental instruct anchor"
```

tom: deploying policy override to edge:```
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/routing/overrides -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"selector": {"interface":"embedding"}, "route": {"model":"stable-embed-v1"}, "ttl": 300}'
```

maria: both commands applied. I can see traffic rehydrating to stable-embed-v1 in traces. 5xxs trending down but some stragglers in eu-west-1.

incident-bot: System note: fallback events suppressed for alias 'embed-default' while override in place.

sanjay: checking metrics — error rate fell from 18% -> 2.1% over 10m. latency unaffected. good sign.

product-ops: reached out to impacted customers, offered rollback window and ETA for full resolution. CS updated tickets.

maria: root cause initial hypothesis: anchor/alias update wire-up pushed an instruct variant into an alias used by embedding clients. routing policy allowed variant incompatibility because the policy matched only on model alias, not interface type.

elaine: that config push slipped into prod due to missing gating in the alias-change flow. I pushed a PR to add an automatic sanity-check: alias to model must match interface capability.

tom: note — we should add a routing policy rule that prevents selecting instruct/gen variants for requests with interface=embedding (defensive). I'll open infra PR.

kyle: did we page oncall-sre? any further actions I should take for next shift?

sanjay: thanks. I've acknowledged the PD incident and tagged next-shift kyle. Mitigation applied. Please monitor for 1h and collect traces for the postmortem.

maria: quick log excerpt showing client error surface for customers:```
client=search-saas-llc req_id=def456 status=500 err="expected embeddings array, got text" ts=2026-08-12T14:22:10Z
```

product-ops: summary for execs: small number of customers impacted, mitigation completed within ~18m from first alert, temporary routing override applied, full rollback of alias completed. CS follow-ups in progress.

elaine: I'll revert the temporary override after 1h if stable, and open the postmortem draft. tagging infra and product for follow-up on policy hardening.

sanjay: marking incident as mitigated in pagerduty. leaving assigned to kyle for monitoring and postmortem ownership.

on-call-bot: Handoff: sanjay -> kyle for next 4h monitoring window. :white_check_mark:

kyle: ack. will keep watch and collect logs/traces for the postmortem. thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) by sanjay. Follow-up: postmortem due in 72h; label: routing-policy, alias-misanchor, embedding-impact.
